notes: DECISION: the dark file gives the fish a white outline (rule 4: black touching the tile -> white). The fish's fills stay readable on dark without it, so keeping the black outline on dark is the other choice. TinyFish's homepage SVG favicon (icon0.svg) only wraps a PNG; its apple-touch icon puts the fish on a lime tile, which the SVG icon does not have. The company's only knock-out (KO) files are all-white horizontal logo/wordmark, not a coloured dark icon.
